sourceSentences: Fiora identifies the Vitals of nearby enemy champions, marked as an arc around them in North-, East-, South- or Westward direction.

Vitals take 1.75 seconds to become targetable and linger for 13.25 seconds afterwards while Fiora remains near the target, otherwise the Vital will disappear. After a Vital expires, Fiora identifies a new one on her target.
Vitals can be triggered by any source of damage Fiora deals, except those with default damage and reactive damage types.
Vitals spawn directions alternate in a Northeast-Southwest pattern. Other than that, they have a 50% chance to spawn North or East, or South or West, respectively.
Vitals are identified upon an enemy gaining sight of Fiora, and they are maintained while enemies maintain sight of Fiora.
If the enemy has no sight of Fiora, Vitals are not identified.
Fiora dashes in the target direction, then stabs a nearby enemy based on a priority. Stabbing a target reduces Lunge's cooldown by 50%.
Fiora can cast any of her abilities during the dash.
Nearest enemy champion with their Vital facing Fiora.
Fiora enters a defensive stance for 0.75 seconds, during which she is unable to act, prevents all incoming non-turret damage, and gains debuff immunity.
If Riposte negates at least one hostile immobilizing effect, Fiora stuns the target for the same duration instead.
The shock missile will be fired from wherever Fiora is after the first 0.5 seconds of Riposte.
Fiora empowers her next two basic attacks on-attack within 4 seconds to gain range and bonus attack speed.
Bladework basic attack resets Fiora's basic attack timer.
Fiora challenges the target enemy champion for 8 seconds, highlighting all four of their Vitals after a 0.5-second delay.
While near the target, Fiora gains Duelist's Dance bonus movement speed.
When you hit the vital from max range, they can't hit you back.
They either spawn top and right or left and bottom and they alternate from that pattern.
If you just walk away, you can reset the vital and it's guaranteed to spawn on the opposite side of the pattern.
vitals will only spawn if both champions see each other.
You can use W while dashing with Q. With this technique, you can purposely get hit by CC and use it against enemies without them even realizing it.
You can't cast ultimate while you're channeling W, so you're going to need to press QRW to cast everything at the same time.
You can create a five vital combo by hitting a vital first, then instantly ulting to spawn in all four vitals.
you can Q and W at the same time and kind of transport your W. This is very good in moments where you're chasing down an enemy.
But the even better way to do it to QRW, you can't QW WR cuz you can't ult during your W.
Literally, anything that does damage from Fiora that is not a dot or ignite procs vitals.
So, there has to be a line between you and the enemy that that crosses the vital.
Both champions have to have vision of each other. If both champions have vision of each other, vitals spawn.
An example of this is just doing auto EQ auto. That is an ult combo without using hydra, without using flash, without using W.
if you're chasing an enemy champion and he's just slightly out of your range, like ever so slightly, your E gives you extra range.
If you're getting chased, use your ult for move speed.
For combos, start Q to proc a vital into your ultimate and W. You then need to proc the other three vitals with an attack into your two quick E attacks as you move around them.
And if it is behind your opponent simply walk out of the range until it resets.
However, if she blocks a hard crowd control effect, she instead stuns the target.
